title: hieracium vulgatum subsp. exutum
intro: Hieracium vulgatum subsp. exutum, commonly known as hawkweed, is a species of flowering plant in the sunflower family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, antimicrobial properties, and antioxidant activity. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium vulgatum subsp. exutum include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antipyretic effects, making it useful for treating various conditions such as wounds, infections, and fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
